lean.faithfulness_note: Proved over Q(q) = RatFunc Q, q the indeterminate: no nonzero (a,...,h) satisfies (aXY+bX+cY+d) - T(eXY+fX+gY+h) = 0 for all rational x,y>1 (given as even-length regular continued fractions), with X=[x]_q, Y=[y]_q, T=[xy]_q, where [.]_q is the nested Morier-Genoud--Ovsienko formula (qcf). The 8x8 relation matrix at eight explicit sample pairs has full rank 8 (rank_eq_eight); the determinant is shown nonzero by specialising q=2 with an exact rational inverse, then transferred to Q(q). Differences from the source scripts: a different, smaller set of eight rational pairs (non-integer x and y); the relation is assumed only at rational x,y>1 (the source assumes it for all real x,y>1, which implies this), so the Lean statement is at least as strong. Controls and the check of qcf against a reference tool were run outside Lean.
lean.covers: Lean 4 proves [xy]_q is not bihomographic in [x]_q and [y]_q over Q(q), with the same relation and rank-8 certificate as for addition. That the q-reversal is not the obstruction here is a computation, not a Lean result.
